name: Error Reporting: AI-Powered Recommendations
description: Recommendations error reporting with AI-driven fix suggestions! This module not only identifies issues but also provides smart, context-aware solutions — complete with step-by-step guidance and code snippets.
project_description: Submodule of Error Reporting. Adds an AI-driven fix-suggestion feature: a "Suggest AI Fix" button on the enhanced error page posts the failing stack frame (code, file, line) and the error message to a configured AI provider (via the drupal/ai module) and shows the returned suggestion, with step-by-step guidance and code snippets, in a modal. Requires the error_reporting and ai modules.
